blocks.text: Yeh chapter 21 (Halogenoalkanes) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 4 number ka hai (wazahat, equations, zaroorat ho to diagram), aur chapter ke numericals qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain. Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What are halogenoalkanes? Explain their classification (i) on the basis of the number of halogen atoms (ii) monohalogenoalkanes into primary, secondary and tertiary, with examples. (4 marks)
(Halogenoalkanes kya hain? In ki taqseem samjhayein (i) halogen atoms ki tadaad ki bunyad par (ii) monohalogenoalkanes ki primary, secondary aur tertiary mein, misaalon ke saath.)
blocks.explanation:
Jab alkane ke aik ya zyada hydrogen atoms halogen atoms se badal jayein to halogenoalkane banta hai.

(i) Halogen atoms (–X) ki tadaad: mono, di, tri ya poly halogenoalkanes, maslan CH₃X (mono), CH₂X₂ (di), CHX₃ (tri).
Monohalogenoalkanes ko alkyl halides kehte hain, general formula R – X (R = methyl, ethyl, propyl waghaira; X = F, Cl, Br, I).

(ii) Halogen wale carbon ki qisam:
• Primary: halogen wala carbon aik ya kisi carbon se nahi jura, maslan CH₃–Cl (chloromethane), CH₃–CH₂–Cl (chloroethane), CH₃–CH₂–CH₂–Cl (1-chloropropane).
• Secondary: halogen wala carbon seedha do carbon atoms se jura, maslan CH₃–CHCl–CH₃ (2-chloropropane), CH₃–CHCl–CH₂–CH₃ (2-chlorobutane).
• Tertiary: halogen wala carbon seedha teen carbon atoms se jura, maslan (CH₃)₃C–Cl (2-chloro-2-methylpropane).

book_ref.quote: A halogenoalkane is formed when one or more hydrogen atoms of an alkane are replaced by halogen atoms

blocks.prompt:
2 Describe the uses of halogenoalkanes in daily life. Explain the use of halothane and what is replacing CFCs. (4 marks)
(Rozmarra zindagi mein halogenoalkanes ke istemal bayan karein. Halothane ka istemal aur CFCs ki jagah lene wale compounds samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Halogenoalkanes apni khaas chemical stability ki wajah se rozmarra zindagi mein bohat mufeed hain.
• Refrigerants aur propellants: CFCs refrigerants aur aerosol propellants thay. Ab inhein Freons jaise eco-friendly alternatives se badla ja raha hai.
• Dawa: halogenated compounds taaqatwar anesthetics hain. Halothane, CF₃–CHClBr, taaqatwar inhalation anesthetic hai jo surgery mein waqti behoshi laata hai. Pehle istemal hone wali chloroform aur doosri chlorinated anesthetics zehreelay pan aur hifazati khadshat ki wajah se ab mamnoo hain.
• Polymers: yeh PVC (piping) aur PTFE/Teflon (non-stick bartan) ke ahem intermediates hain.

book_ref.quote: Halogenoalkanes are very useful in daily life, primarily due to their specialized chemical stability

blocks.prompt:
3 Describe the preparation of halogenoalkanes from (i) an alkane (ii) an alkene (iii) an alcohol with a halogen acid (iv) an alcohol with PBr₃. Give one equation for each. (4 marks)
(Halogenoalkanes ki tayyari bayan karein (i) alkane se (ii) alkene se (iii) alcohol aur halogen acid se (iv) alcohol aur PBr₃ se. Har aik ki equation dein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Alkane se: roshni ki maujoodgi mein halogenation.
CH₃–CH₃ + Cl₂ —(light)→ CH₃–CH₂–Cl + HCl

(ii) Alkene se: hydrogen halide ki electrophilic addition.
H₂C=CH₂ + HBr → CH₃–CH₂–Br

(iii) Alcohol aur halogen acid se, ZnCl₂ catalyst ke tor par.
CH₃–CH₂–OH + HCl —(ZnCl₂)→ CH₃–CH₂–Cl + H₂O

(iv) Alcohol aur phosphorus trihalide se, jo –OH group ko halo group se badalta hai.
3CH₃–CH₂–OH + PBr₃ → 3CH₃–CH₂–Br + H₃PO₃

book_ref.quote: Halogenoalkanes can be prepared by the halogenation of alkanes in the presence of light

blocks.prompt:
4 Explain, with equations, the special advantage of (i) the thionyl chloride method for chloroalkanes (ii) the potassium bromide–acid method, and why phosphoric acid is preferred for iodoalkanes. (4 marks)
(Equations ke saath samjhayein (i) chloroalkanes ke liye thionyl chloride tareeqe ka khaas faida (ii) potassium bromide–acid tareeqa, aur iodoalkanes ke liye phosphoric acid kyun behtar hai.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Thionyl chloride tareeqa: alcohols pyridine catalyst ke saath SOCl₂ se react karte hain.
CH₃–CH₂–OH + SOCl₂ —(pyridine)→ CH₃–CH₂–Cl + SO₂ + HCl
Yeh khaas tor par mufeed hai kyun ke by-products SO₂ aur HCl gases hain jo nikal jati hain aur khalis product bachta hai.

(ii) KBr–acid tareeqa: alcohol ko KBr aur H₂SO₄ ya H₃PO₄ jaise acid ke saath garam kiya jata hai. Acid pehle KBr se HBr banata hai, jo phir alcohol ko bromoalkane mein badalta hai.
CH₃–CH₂–OH + KBr + H₂SO₄ → CH₃–CH₂–Br + H₂O + KHSO₄
Yeh tareeqa aam tor par bromoalkanes aur iodoalkanes ke liye istemal hota hai.

Iodoalkanes ke liye phosphoric acid: H₃PO₄ kamzor oxidizing agent hai aur iodide ions ko iodine mein kam badalta hai, is liye iodide iodoalkane banane ke liye mojood rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: Phosphoric acid is preferably used to prepare iodoalkanes because it is a weak oxidizing agent

blocks.prompt:
5 Discuss the reactivity of halogenoalkanes in terms of the carbon–halogen bond energies. Give the order of reactivity and other factors that affect it. (4 marks)
(Carbon–halogen bond energies ke hawale se halogenoalkanes ki reactivity par bahas karein. Reactivity ki tarteeb aur doosre asar andaz factors batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Halogenoalkane R – X mein halogen se jure carbon par partial positive aur halogen par partial negative charge hota hai. Tajurbaat batate hain ke C – X bond ki mazbooti asal factor hai: kamzor bond aasaani se tootta hai aur molecule zyada reactive hota hai.

Bond energies (Table 21.1) neeche table mein hain.

Iodo compounds ke bonds sab se kamzor, is liye sab se reactive; fluoro sab se kam:
R–I > R–Br > R–Cl > R–F
C – F bond itna mazboot hai ke fluoroalkanes aam halaat mein react nahi karte.

Doosre factors: bond polarity, steric hindrance aur inductive effect.

book_ref.quote: Experiments have shown that the strength of carbon halogen bond is the main factor

blocks.prompt:
6 Explain why halogenoalkanes undergo nucleophilic substitution and elimination reactions. Write the general equation of each, labelling the species. (4 marks)
(Samjhayein ke halogenoalkanes nucleophilic substitution aur elimination reactions kyun karte hain. Har aik ki aam equation species ke naam ke saath likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
C–X bond carbon aur halogen ki electronegativity ke farq ki wajah se polar hai. Is liye do qisam ke hamle mumkin hain:

(a) Nucleophilic substitution (SN): δ+ carbon electrophilic centre hai jis par nucleophile hamla karta hai; halogen ki jagah koi aur atom ya group aata hai.
Nu⁻ + R–X → R–Nu + X⁻
(attacking nucleophile + substrate molecule → substituted product + leaving group)

(b) Elimination (E): base C–X wale carbon ke saath wale carbon ke hydrogen par hamla karta hai; HX nikalta hai aur alkene banti hai.
H–C–C–X (substrate) → C=C (alkene) + HX (hydrogen halide)

Dono reactions milti julti conditions mein hote hain aur aksar aik doosre se muqabla karte hain.

book_ref.quote: These two possibilities result in two types of reaction of halogenoalkanes

blocks.prompt:
7 Describe the SN2 mechanism using the reaction of bromomethane with hydroxide ion. Discuss its molecularity and kinetics, and explain why primary halogenoalkanes follow it. (4 marks)
(Bromomethane aur hydroxide ion ke reaction se SN2 mechanism bayan karein. Is ki molecularity aur kinetics par bahas karein aur samjhayein ke primary halogenoalkanes ise kyun follow karte hain.)
blocks.explanation:
SN2 (nucleophilic substitution bimolecular) aik qadam ka mechanism hai.

Mechanism: OH⁻ CH₃–Br ke δ+ carbon par leaving group (Br) ke mukhalif taraf se hamla karta hai. Hamla shuru hote hi C–Br bond tootna shuru hota hai; banne aur tootne ki had barabar hai. Transition state [HO---CH₃---Br]⁻ se guzar kar products bante hain:
OH⁻ + CH₃–Br → [HO---CH₃---Br]⁻ → CH₃–OH + Br⁻

Molecularity: yahi aik qadam rate-determining step hai aur is mein do molecules hissa lete hain, is liye bimolecular.

Kinetics: rate alkyl halide aur nucleophile dono par hai:
Rate = k[alkyl halide]¹[nucleophile]¹, order = 1 + 1 = 2 (second order).

Primary halides: steric wajah se; substrate carbon par H atoms ya sirf aik carbon hota hai, is liye nucleophile peechhe se aasaani se hamla kar leta hai. Primary monohalogenoalkanes hamesha SN2 follow karte hain.

book_ref.quote: This is a single step mechanism

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: SN2 ko aise samjhein: nucleophile aage se aata hai to leaving group peechhe se nikalta hai, dono kaam aik saath. Is liye rate mein dono ki concentration aati hai aur order 2 hai.

blocks.prompt:
8 Describe the SN1 mechanism taking 2-bromo-2-methylpropane and hydroxide ion as an example. Explain its rate equation and why tertiary halogenoalkanes follow this mechanism. (4 marks)
(2-bromo-2-methylpropane aur hydroxide ion ki misaal se SN1 mechanism bayan karein. Is ki rate equation aur tertiary halogenoalkanes ke ise follow karne ki wajah samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
SN1 (nucleophilic substitution unimolecular) mein do qadam hain.

Qadam 1 (aahista): aqueous acetone ya aqueous ethyl alcohol mein alkyl halide ki reversible ionization se carbocation intermediate banta hai.
(CH₃)₃C–Br ⇌ (CH₃)₃C⁺ + Br⁻
Qadam 2 (tez): carbocation par nucleophile hamla karta hai.
(CH₃)₃C⁺ + OH⁻ → (CH₃)₃C–OH

Qadam 1 mein covalent bond tootta hai, is liye yeh qadam 2 (ions ka milna) se aahista hai; yahi rate-determining step hai. Is mein sirf aik molecule hissa leta hai, is liye mechanism unimolecular aur first order hai:
Rate = k[alkyl halide]

Tertiary halides hamesha SN1 follow karte hain kyun ke (i) mustaqil tertiary carbocation banta hai, aur (ii) electrophilic carbon par teen bhaari groups nucleophile ko leaving group ke peechhe se hamla karne nahi dete.

book_ref.quote: This type of mechanism involves two steps

blocks.prompt:
9 What is a carbocation? Explain the order of stability of carbocations and its importance in deciding the mechanism followed by primary, secondary and tertiary halogenoalkanes. (4 marks)
(Carbocation kya hai? Carbocations ki stability ki tarteeb aur primary, secondary aur tertiary halogenoalkanes ka mechanism tay karne mein is ki ahmiyat samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Carbocation woh positive charge wala carbon intermediate hai jo SN1 (aur E1) ke pehle qadam mein alkyl halide ke C–X bond ki ionization se banta hai.

Stability ki tarteeb:
tertiary > secondary > primary > methyl carbocation
Alkyl (CH₃) groups positive carbon ki taraf electrons dhakelte hain (positive inductive effect, +I). Tertiary mein teen, secondary mein do, primary mein aik aur methyl mein koi group nahi; +I kam hone se stability kam hoti hai.

Ahmiyat: carbocation rate-determining step mein banta hai, is liye jitna mustaqil carbocation, utni aasaani se banta hai.
• Tertiary halides mustaqil 3° carbocation banate hain (aur peechhe ka hamla rokte hain): SN1.
• Primary halides ka carbocation ghair mustaqil hota magar peechhe ka hamla aasaan hai: SN2.
• Secondary halides solvent ki nauiyat ke mutabiq SN2 aur SN1 dono follow kar sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: The mechanism shows that a carbocation is formed in the rate-determining step

blocks.prompt:
10 Bromoethane reacts with OH⁻ by the SN2 mechanism with k = 3.0 × 10⁻⁴ dm³ mol⁻¹ s⁻¹. Calculate (i) the rate when [bromoethane] = 0.25 mol dm⁻³ and [OH⁻] = 0.15 mol dm⁻³ (ii) the rate when [OH⁻] is doubled at the same [bromoethane]. (4 marks)
(Bromoethane OH⁻ se SN2 mechanism se react karta hai, k = 3.0 × 10⁻⁴ dm³ mol⁻¹ s⁻¹. Nikalein (i) rate jab [bromoethane] = 0.25 mol dm⁻³ aur [OH⁻] = 0.15 mol dm⁻³ (ii) rate jab [bromoethane] wohi rahe aur [OH⁻] double ho.)
blocks.explanation: SN2 second order hai, Rate = k[alkyl halide][nucleophile]; values daalein, phir dekhein ke rate [OH⁻] ke seedha mutanasib hai.

book_ref.quote: Kinetic studies of the reactions involving SN2 mechanism have shown

steps: SN2 ki rate equation: Rate = k[CH₃CH₂Br][OH⁻]
blocks.final_answer: (i) 1.1 × 10⁻⁵ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹ (ii) 2.3 × 10⁻⁵ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹; rate do guna ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
11 2-Bromo-2-methylpropane is hydrolysed by the SN1 mechanism with k = 4.0 × 10⁻⁵ s⁻¹. Calculate the rate when (i) [alkyl halide] = 0.20 mol dm⁻³ and [OH⁻] = 0.10 mol dm⁻³ (ii) [OH⁻] is raised to 0.20 mol dm⁻³ (iii) [alkyl halide] is raised to 0.40 mol dm⁻³ with [OH⁻] = 0.10 mol dm⁻³. (4 marks)
(2-Bromo-2-methylpropane SN1 mechanism se hydrolyse hota hai, k = 4.0 × 10⁻⁵ s⁻¹. Rate nikalein jab (i) [alkyl halide] = 0.20 mol dm⁻³ aur [OH⁻] = 0.10 mol dm⁻³ (ii) [OH⁻] 0.20 mol dm⁻³ kar diya jaye (iii) [alkyl halide] 0.40 mol dm⁻³ aur [OH⁻] = 0.10 mol dm⁻³ ho.)
blocks.explanation: SN1 first order hai aur rate equation mein sirf alkyl halide hai, Rate = k[alkyl halide]; nucleophile ki concentration ka asar nahi.

book_ref.quote: The rate equation of such reactions can be written as follows

steps: SN1 ki rate equation: Rate = k[(CH₃)₃CBr]
(ii) [OH⁻] rate equation mein nahi, is liye Rate = 8.0 × 10⁻⁶ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹ (wohi)

blocks.prompt:
12 What is β-elimination? Describe the E2 mechanism using bromoethane, and give its molecularity and rate equation. (4 marks)
(β-elimination kya hai? Bromoethane se E2 mechanism bayan karein aur is ki molecularity aur rate equation dein.)
blocks.explanation:
β-Elimination: woh reaction jis mein base ke β-hydrogen par hamle se alkyl halide ke β-carbon ka hydrogen aur saath wale carbon ka halogen nikal jate hain. Substitution product ke bajaye alkene banti hai. Yeh substitution ke saath hote hain aur aksar muqabla karte hain; E2 ya E1 follow karte hain.

E2 mechanism (aik qadam): base β-hydrogen par hamla karta hai aur leaving group usi waqt nikalta hai, C=C banta hai. Bromoethane mein base CH₃ se H leta hai, C–H ke electrons C=C banate hain aur Br, Br⁻ ban kar nikalta hai:
Base⁻ + H–CH₂–CH₂–Br → CH₂=CH₂ + H–Base + Br⁻

Molecularity: do (bimolecular), SN2 ki tarah.
Rate = k[alkyl halide]¹[base]¹, order = 1 + 1 = 2 (second order).
Primary halogenoalkanes aam tor par E2 follow karte hain.

book_ref.quote: This reaction occurs when a base attacks the

blocks.prompt:
13 Describe the E1 mechanism using 2-bromo-2-methylpropane. Which halogenoalkanes follow E1, E2 or both? (4 marks)
(2-bromo-2-methylpropane se E1 mechanism bayan karein. Kaun se halogenoalkanes E1, E2 ya dono follow karte hain?)
blocks.explanation:
E1 (elimination unimolecular) ke do qadam hain.

Qadam 1 (aahista): SN1 ki tarah substrate ionize ho kar carbocation banata hai.
(CH₃)₃C–Br ⇌ (CH₃)₃C⁺ + Br⁻ (3° carbocation)
Qadam 2 (tez): base β-hydrogen par hamla karta hai; C–H ke electrons C=C banate hain.
(CH₃)₃C⁺ + Base⁻ → (CH₃)₂C=CH₂ (2-methylpropene) + H–Base

Aahista qadam mein sirf alkyl halide hissa leta hai, is liye E1 unimolecular hai; rate sirf alkyl halide ki concentration par hai: Rate = k[alkyl halide].

Kaun se substrates: primary aam tor par E2, tertiary E1, aur secondary solvent ke intikhab ke mutabiq E2 aur E1 dono.

book_ref.quote: E1 mechanism is a unimolecular mechanism

blocks.prompt:
14 Bromoethane undergoes E2 elimination with a base, k = 5.0 × 10⁻³ dm³ mol⁻¹ s⁻¹. Calculate (i) the rate when [bromoethane] = 0.10 mol dm⁻³ and [base] = 0.50 mol dm⁻³ (ii) the rate when [bromoethane] is tripled and [base] is halved. (4 marks)
(Bromoethane base ke saath E2 elimination karta hai, k = 5.0 × 10⁻³ dm³ mol⁻¹ s⁻¹. Nikalein (i) rate jab [bromoethane] = 0.10 mol dm⁻³ aur [base] = 0.50 mol dm⁻³ (ii) rate jab [bromoethane] triple aur [base] aadha ho.)
blocks.explanation: E2 second order hai, Rate = k[alkyl halide][base]; dono concentrations rate badalti hain.

book_ref.quote: Like SN2 reactions, the molecularity of E2 reactions is also two

steps: E2 ki rate equation: Rate = k[CH₃CH₂Br][base]
blocks.final_answer: (i) 2.5 × 10⁻⁴ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹ (ii) 3.8 × 10⁻⁴ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹ (1.5 guna)

blocks.prompt:
15 Explain how sodium hydroxide gives both substitution and elimination products with bromoethane. Write both equations and state the conditions. (4 marks)
(Samjhayein ke sodium hydroxide bromoethane ke saath substitution aur elimination dono products kaise deta hai. Dono equations aur conditions likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Halogenoalkane sodium hydroxide se conditions ke mutabiq substitution aur elimination dono products deta hai, kyun ke hydroxide ion achha nucleophile bhi hai aur achha base bhi.

Nucleophile ke tor par OH⁻ δ+ carbon par hamla karke halogen ki jagah leta hai aur alcohol banta hai (substitution). Aqueous NaOH ke saath:
CH₃–CH₂–Br + NaOH —(aqueous)→ CH₃–CH₂–OH + NaBr

Base ke tor par OH⁻ β-hydrogen hatata hai aur halogen nikalta hai, alkene banti hai (elimination). Alcohol mein NaOH ke saath:
CH₃–CH₂–Br + NaOH —(alcohol)→ CH₂=CH₂ + H₂O + NaBr

Conditions: reactions zyada temperature par reflux mein hote hain taa ke volatile products zaya na hon.

book_ref.quote: Hydroxide ion is both a good nucleophile and a good base

blocks.prompt:
16 Describe the step-by-step reaction of ammonia with bromoethane up to the quaternary ammonium salt. Why is a mixture of products obtained? (4 marks)
(Ammonia aur bromoethane ka reaction qadam ba qadam quaternary ammonium salt tak bayan karein. Products ka mixture kyun milta hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Ammonia achha nucleophile hai; N ka lone pair bromoethane ke δ+ carbon par hamla karta hai aur Br nikalta hai.

Qadam 1: NH₃ + C₂H₅Br → C₂H₅NH₂ (ethanamine) + HBr
Qadam 2: ethanamine bhi nucleophile hai aur ammonia se muqabla karti hai:
C₂H₅NH₂ + C₂H₅Br → (C₂H₅)₂NH (N-ethylethanamine, diethyl amine) + HBr
Qadam 3: N-ethylethanamine doosre bromoethane par hamla karti hai:
(C₂H₅)₂NH + C₂H₅Br → (C₂H₅)₃N (N,N-diethylethanamine) + HBr
Qadam 4: bromoethane bohat zyada ho to quaternary ammonium salt banta hai:
(C₂H₅)₃N + C₂H₅Br → (C₂H₅)₄N⁺ Br⁻ (kitab mein naam N,N,N-triethylethanamine bromide)

Mixture: har bani amine par lone pair hota hai aur woh nucleophile hai, is liye aage react karti hai. Halogenoalkane aur ammonia ki miqdaar ko ehtiyat se qaboo karke mukhtalif amines li jati hain.

book_ref.quote: Different types of amines can be produced if the amounts of halogenoalkane and ammonia are carefully controlled

blocks.prompt:
17 Describe the reaction of halogenoalkanes with aqueous silver nitrate. How does it help to identify the halogen and compare the reactivities of halogenoalkanes? (4 marks)
(Halogenoalkanes ke aqueous silver nitrate ke saath reaction ko bayan karein. Yeh halogen ki pehchan aur halogenoalkanes ki reactivity ke muqable mein kaise madad deta hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Reaction paani aur ethanol ke mixture mein kiya jata hai; ethanol halogenoalkane ko ghoolne mein madad deta hai. Paani nucleophile ban kar halide ion ki jagah leta hai:
CH₃–CH₂–X + H–OH → CH₃–CH₂–OH + H⁺ + X⁻

Pehchan: azad halide ion silver nitrate se react karke khaas rang ka precipitate deta hai:
Ag⁺ + Cl⁻ → AgCl (safaid ppt)
Ag⁺ + Br⁻ → AgBr (cream peela ppt)
Ag⁺ + I⁻ → AgI (chamakdar peela ppt)

Reactivity: jitna jaldi precipitate aaye, halogenoalkane utna reactive. Iodoalkane bromoalkane se kahin jaldi precipitate deta hai, aur chloroalkane bohat aahista react karta hai. Yeh C–X bond energies (C–I sab se kamzor) se mutabiqat rakhta hai: R–I > R–Br > R–Cl.

book_ref.quote: Comparing the rates of formation of silver halides in this reaction gives us a clue

blocks.prompt:
18 How are halogenoarenes prepared? Explain, with the help of delocalisation, why chlorobenzene is less reactive than a halogenoalkane towards nucleophiles. (4 marks)
(Halogenoarenes kaise banaye jate hain? Delocalisation ki madad se samjhayein ke chlorobenzene nucleophiles ke liye halogenoalkane se kam reactive kyun hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Tayyari: chlorobenzene aur bromobenzene benzene ko chlorine ya bromine ke saath anhydrous FeCl₃ ya FeBr₃ catalyst ki maujoodgi mein room temperature par react kara kar banaye jate hain. Yeh electrophilic aromatic substitution hai:
C₆H₆ + Cl₂ —(FeCl₃)→ C₆H₅Cl + HCl
C₆H₆ + Br₂ —(FeBr₃)→ C₆H₅Br + HBr

Kam reactivity: halogenoalkane mein C–X ka δ+ carbon nucleophiles ko hamle ki dawat deta hai (substitution; base se elimination). Chlorobenzene mein chlorine ka lone pair aromatic ring mein phail (delocalise) jata hai. Is se C—Cl bond mein partial double-bond character aata hai, bond mazboot aur torna mushkil ho jata hai. Is liye halogenoarenes kam reactive aur synthesis mein kam mufeed hain.

book_ref.quote: Halogenoarenes like chlorobenzene and bromobenzene are prepared by reacting benzene
